verdict.overall: Since Sunday the big story is a broad pullback: TSLA, PLTR, AMAT, BE, APP and SPY all saw magnets slide lower and several nearest-week setups flip to opposing, meaning resistance above price has gotten heavier even as prices dropped. GOOGL and AVGO are the exceptions, improving from opposing to neutral/supportive as pressure eased, making them the better-looking range setups right now, while APP, BE, PLTR and AMAT look weakest given persistent or newly-opposing scores and falling floors. Confidence is rising for GOOGL/AVGO and falling for the rest; main caution is AVGO's Dec 9 earnings falling inside this window and the sheer size of this week's price swings distorting magnets.
